description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to blacklisted emails within the Coocook schema. It includes methods for adding emails to the blacklist and checking if an email is okay, along with some configuration for email hashing and storage.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistEmail
classes.description: A ResultSet class for managing blacklisted emails, extending the base ResultSet class and including specific components for blacklist handling.

methods.name: add_email
methods.description: Adds a literal email address to the blacklist.

methods.name: is_email_ok
methods.description: Checks if the provided email address is not blacklisted.

methods.name: _blacklist_default_type
methods.description: Returns the default hashing type used for blacklisted emails.

methods.name: _blacklist_type_column
methods.description: Returns the name of the database column storing the email type.

methods.name: _blacklist_value_column
methods.description: Returns the name of the database column storing the email hash.
